all_date_exact_cwd_scan.classification: bounded exact session_meta cwd inventory; model events come only from source turn_context model fields
all_date_exact_cwd_scan.counting_note: session_files counts distinct source paths, while metadata_session_ids deduplicates the source-declared identifier. Copied and forked rollouts can share a metadata identifier, so metadata-ID counts are not comparable to the initial day's file-level session count.
all_date_exact_cwd_scan.hash_note: Every hash is a mutable-source snapshot read during the stated scan interval; no source was inferred complete. The digest commits to the restricted per-source session-ID/hash manifest without publishing its filesystem location.

limitations: The all-date scan selected Codex files by the first session_meta record's exact cwd; it did not inspect prompts or tool outputs for model identities.
All source hashes are bounded mutable snapshots, not completion claims.
Model event counts count source records carrying a model field, not unique turns or ideas.

exact_cwd_snapshot.hash_note: Every hash is a mutable-source snapshot read during the scan interval.
exact_cwd_snapshot.selection_note: Claude files were searched across all encoded project directories and retained only when a source record declared an exact project cwd; parent-directory storage therefore does not exclude a matching session.

claude.classification: exact modelUsage identifiers; broader unmatched identifiers are not attributed to Stafford38

archive_coverage.private_originals: retained in the restricted evidence vault; exact vault locator is intentionally not published
archive_coverage.coverage_cutoff: checked-in archive ends 2026-08-30; private source sessions reach 2026-09-05

recollection_status.do_not_infer: aliases, task labels, prose mentions, and model-family recollections do not establish backend execution
